props.name: defaultSearchValue
props.description: The search box's text when the list first draws, such as a search carried over.

props.name: empty
props.description: The line drawn when there are no items at all.

props.name: fill
props.description: The list takes the height it is given and its rows scroll inside it, for a sheet or panel whose main content is the list. Otherwise a list with a search scrolls past 18rem.

props.name: footer
props.description: A row of the caller's under the list, inside its frame, that stays in view while the rows scroll: the way out when the item isn't there, such as "Create an agent".

props.name: groups
props.description: Headings that split the rows by kind, in this order, such as Agents then People. Each item names its group; a group with no rows to show, or a search that leaves it empty, draws no heading.

props.name: noMatchLabel
props.description: The line under the chosen rows when nothing else matches.

props.name: search
props.description: When the search box shows. `"always"` when people look for an item they know by name, such as a person: the box shows at any count, and with a mouse or trackpad focus starts in it. `"auto"` when people choose by comparing the rows: the box shows only above 5 items.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: The search box's accessible name. Required: any list can come to search, since `"auto"` shows the box once the items, usually from data, pass 5.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: The search box's text, for a caller that uses it: a "Create “…”" row named after it, or a no-match line that quotes it. With it, the caller owns the text, and `onSearchValueChange` reports each change.
